quotes.text: Before I was baptized into the Church, the missionaries taught me about tithes and offerings. After my baptism, through summer jobs, I had the opportunity to pay full tithes and fast offerings. However, at that time, I did not fully understand the meaning of the promises and blessings associated with obedience to this law.
quotes.speaker: Elder PatricioÂ M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We were deeply moved. Everything she said made sense from a worldly perspective. Although we bore testimony of the great blessings the Lord promises to those who obey this commandment, she insisted that she could not do it.
quotes.speaker: Elder PatricioÂ M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The next morning, I called my mission president, President Fernando Caballero, to seek his counsel. In my mind, I wondered whether the Lord might have an exception for someone in her circumstances.
quotes.speaker: Elder PatricioÂ M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Those words became engraved upon my heart. My companion and I decided to pray and fast because two days later we would return to review the commandments once again before her baptism.
quotes.speaker: Elder PatricioÂ M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Throughout my life, I have learned to trust in the Lord, and I have seen innumerable blessings come to my family and me as we have sought to faithfully live the law of tithing and offerings. Some blessings have been temporal, others spiritual, but all have strengthened our testimony that the Lord always fulfills His promises and that the windows of heaven are opened according to our obedience.
quotes.speaker: Elder PatricioÂ M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: My wife often teaches a principle that has become very meaningful in our family: We keep the commandments because we love God, not merely because we hope to receive the blessings that come from obedience. Commandments are given to draw us closer to the Savior, to protect us, and to help us remain free from sin and many of the challenges the world presents.
quotes.speaker: Elder PatricioÂ M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: During my years of service in Central America, I have seen men and women prosper both temporally and spiritually. I have met families who once worried about their next meal but who now enjoy greater stability. I have known children of God who once could not afford a pair of shoes and who today, through faith and diligent effort, own successful businesses. I have also witnessed the Lord open doors for employment, provide education, strengthen marriages, and fill faithful hearts with peace and hope.
quotes.speaker: Elder PatricioÂ M. Giuffra
quotes.talk: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
